finalText:
Created `validate_email.py` with an `is_valid_email(email: str) -> bool` function.

It uses a regex that requires:
- a local part of standard allowed characters (letters, digits, and common symbols like `.!#$%&'*+/=?^_\`{|}~-`)
- an `@`
- a domain with at least one dot, valid label characters, and no leading/trailing hyphens per label
- a max length of 254 characters (RFC 5321 limit)

Note: this covers the vast majority of real-world addresses but isn't a full RFC 5322 parser (no comments, quoted local parts, or IP-literal domains). For production use with untrusted signups, pair it with a confirmation email — no regex fully guarantees deliverability.
